decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed floodlights are for purposes ancillary to sport within an area of Metropolitan Open Land and are considered to be of a size, specification and design so as not to have an adverse affect upon the character and appearance of this area or upon the surrounding land uses. This is in accordance with ENV.B.1.1 (New Development), ENV.N.1.5 (Protection of Metropolitan Open Land) and ENV.N.1.6 (Metropolitan Open Land Acceptable Uses) of the adopted London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - On no day shall the floodlights hereby permtited be illuminated between the hours of 23:00 and 08:00 without the prior consent of the Local Planning Authority.

To preserve the amenity of nearby residential properties.
description: Installation of 3 x floodlight columns to training pitch (Pitch 2) and re-placement of existing floodlights opposite.
